what: Clicking a link to another page covers the screen with square cells — vertical columns fill from the bottom at .025s intervals and each cell turns on in a shuffled order. When the next page opens, the same cells retract in reverse

options.dur: Clear — seconds for one row or cell to lift away on the arrived page, default 0.7
options.cover: Cover — time (seconds) for one line or cell to fill on the leaving page, same as the default dur. At 0 it skips the cover, switches immediately and only uncovers the arriving page (for screens that switch often, like apps)
options.each: Gap between lines (seconds), default 0.025. Filling the cover takes cover + each × (line count − 1) seconds, and then the next page is called.

use: <div data-fx="pixel-wipe" data-fx-pixel-wipe="cover: 0; dur: 0.25; each: 0.003"> — Covers and then uncovers when moving between pages that use the same part. Default is the original length (about 1.1s). With cover: 0 it navigates the moment you press and only uncovers on the arrival side

from.where: All section page transitions (shared.js leave) — 12 rows × square cells filling the screen height, each row .025s later, cells .3s power1.in (shuffled order, in-row spread .3×.6) covering in .6s then clearing in the same order .3s power1.out, the new section goes to the top after 1.3s (barba 2.10.3 sync)
